en: Black‑and‑white view over a landscaped park with curving paths and benches in the foreground. Behind the trees stand several ornate late‑19th‑century buildings; on the hillside above are terraced vineyards and large villa‑ or hotel‑like structures. On the slope, a painted sign on a building reads "WEINGRUBER CAFE PARK SCHONBRUNN." The scene suggests a spa or resort town surrounded by wooded hills.
